description: A Google Sheets or Excel file the user added in the app, with its sheets, read with the user's own Google or Microsoft account. Fails with user-missing-oauth when the user hasn't connected that account in the app. Find the file's id with searchSpreadsheets, then add a range of one of its sheets to a report with addReportDatasheets by the sheet's id.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The spreadsheet whose sheets to list, by its `id` from `searchSpreadsheets`. This is Rollstack's identifier, not the file's id in Google Drive, OneDrive or SharePoint. It must be one of your own spreadsheets in Rollstack: another member's spreadsheet returns `404`, as does an Excel file stored in Google Drive.

name: getSpreadsheet
title: Get spreadsheet
